sentences.ar: تاني يوم الصبح، إجا شتربة عند الأسد زي كل يوم.
sentences.en: The next morning, Shatraba came to the lion as he did every day.

sentences.ar: بس هالمرة كان ماشي على مهل، وراسه واطي، وقرونه لقدام.
sentences.en: But this time he was walking slowly, his head low, his horns forward.

sentences.ar: كان خايف، والخايف بيمشي هيك.
sentences.en: He was afraid, and the fearful walk this way.

sentences.ar: الأسد شافه من بعيد، وتذكر كلام دمنة.
sentences.en: The lion saw him from afar, and remembered Dimna's words.

sentences.ar: قال بقلبه: قرونه لقدام.
sentences.en: He said to himself: his horns forward.

sentences.ar: إذن صحيح.
sentences.en: So it is true.

sentences.ar: وقف الأسد، وعينه صارت حمرا، وديله بيضرب الأرض.
sentences.en: The lion stood up, his eyes went red, and his tail beat the ground.

sentences.ar: كان غضبان، والغضبان بيوقف هيك.
sentences.en: He was angry, and the angry stand this way.

sentences.ar: شتربة شاف عينه الحمرا وديله، وتذكر كلام دمنة.
sentences.en: Shatraba saw his red eyes and his tail, and remembered Dimna's words.

sentences.ar: قال بقلبه: عينه حمرا.
sentences.en: He said to himself: his eyes are red.

sentences.ar: إذن صحيح.
sentences.en: So it is true.

sentences.ar: كل واحد شاف بالتاني اللي دمنة قال له يشوفه.
sentences.en: Each saw in the other what Dimna had told him to see.

sentences.ar: والخوف بيشبه العداوة كتير، لدرجة إن ما حدا بيفرق بينهم.
sentences.en: And fear looks a great deal like enmity, so much that no one tells them apart.

sentences.ar: ما حدا حكى كلمة.
sentences.en: No one said a word.

sentences.ar: ما حدا سأل.
sentences.en: No one asked.

sentences.ar: لو سأل الأسد: يا شتربة، ليش قرونك لقدام؟
sentences.en: Had the lion asked: Shatraba, why are your horns forward?

sentences.ar: كان الثور جاوب: لأني خايف منك.
sentences.en: The ox would have answered: because I fear you.

sentences.ar: ولو سأل الثور: يا ملك، ليش عينك حمرا؟
sentences.en: And had the ox asked: my king, why are your eyes red?

sentences.ar: كان الأسد جاوب: لأني خايف منك.
sentences.en: The lion would have answered: because I fear you.

sentences.ar: وكان كل إشي انحل بسؤال.
sentences.en: And everything would have been settled by a question.

sentences.ar: بس ما حدا سأل.
sentences.en: But no one asked.

sentences.ar: نط الأسد، وشتربة ضرب بقرونه.
sentences.en: The lion leapt, and Shatraba struck with his horns.

sentences.ar: انخانقوا بلا ما حدا منهم بده الخناقة.
sentences.en: They fought without either of them wanting the fight.

sentences.ar: الغبار طلع، والحيوانات هربت من الصوت.
sentences.en: The dust rose, and the animals fled from the noise.

sentences.ar: وبالآخر وقع الثور عالأرض ومات.
sentences.en: And at last the ox fell to the ground and died.

sentences.ar: والأسد وقف فوقه، وهو بينزف من كتفه وصدره.
sentences.en: And the lion stood over him, bleeding from his shoulder and chest.

sentences.ar: لما هدي الغبار، قعد الأسد جنب شتربة.
sentences.en: When the dust settled, the lion sat beside Shatraba.

sentences.ar: كان الغضب راح، وما ضل غير الحزن.
sentences.en: The anger had gone, and nothing was left but grief.

sentences.ar: قال: شو عملت؟
sentences.en: He said: what have I done?

sentences.ar: خسرت أحسن صاحب عندي.
sentences.en: I have lost the best friend I had.

sentences.ar: ومن بعيد، بين الشجر، كان دمنة بيتفرج.
sentences.en: And from afar, among the trees, Dimna was watching.

sentences.ar: وجنبه كليلة، وهو بيبكي.
sentences.en: And beside him Kalila, weeping.
